Resolves #21233

#21225 turned the theme sources into plain CSS under `resources/css` and made `build-themes` copy them instead of compiling them. This PR brings the six guides that still described the Sass tree in line with that. Documentation only: no code, config or public behavior changes.

- `StylingAndTheming.md`: every path, code fence and "SCSS" mention follows the CSS tree. Sass `//` comments in the snippets become block comments. The build section now describes the copy through postcss (autoprefixer, plus cssnano for esm and production) and the `"neo": {"css": "<dir>"}` package field. The watcher notes drop partials and shared mixins, which no longer exist, and use the README's wording for a sheet that fails to parse. The theme generator step says the shared motion values come from `src/Global.css` instead of Sass imports.
- `DockLayouts.md`, `DockLayoutsAdoption.md`, `DockLayoutsStyling.md`: the token paths point at `resources/css/src/dashboard/Container.css` and `resources/css/theme-*/dashboard/`, and the snippets, which were already plain CSS, use `css` fences.
- `CodebaseOverview.md`: the theming engine entry names `/resources/css/` and its current size (733 files, about 25.3k lines).
- `Earthquakes.md`: `build-themes` copies the plain CSS sources in `resources/css` into `dist`.

Evidence: L1 (grep of the guides, path existence check on `dev` after #21225, read against `buildScripts/README.md` and `buildScripts/create/theme.mjs`) -> L1 required (documentation ACs).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `git grep -niE "resources/scss\|\.scss\b\|\bsass\b" -- learn ':!learn/blog'` prints nothing on this branch. |
| AC-2 | Every concrete path the six files name exists on `dev` at `8f03399`, including `resources/css/src/dashboard/Container.css`, `resources/css/src/button/Base.css`, `resources/css/src/apps/portal/Viewport.css`, the three `list/Base.css` sheets and `src/Global.css`. The rest are placeholders (`theme-my-awesome-theme`, `my-workspace/...`, `theme-*`, `<root>`). The three dock tokens the adoption guide quotes are declared in `Container.css`. |
| AC-3 | `StylingAndTheming.md` §9 describes the copy build through postcss, and §8 item 5 the `"neo": {"css": "resources/css"}` field and the `neo.css` roots between the engine and the workspace. |

None substantive. Heading anchors in `StylingAndTheming.md` change with the headings (for example "3. SCSS & Theming" becomes "3. CSS & Theming"); nothing under `learn/` or `src/` links to the old anchors.
